One person has died and dozens may be trapped as Typhoon Kalmaegi causes severe flooding in Talisay City, Philippines, destroying homes. 

Al Jazeera’s @barnabychuck reports. https://t.co/w59HnqSYw0

JUST IN: Typhoon Kalmaegi hits Vietnam after killing at least 114 in the Philippines and flooding towns.
Over 260,000 soldiers on standby as winds reach 92mph.
Six airports closed; hundreds of flights likely affected. https://t.co/eQSZ0c62gM
